question: Should OpenClaw expose a public reset-startup prompt override, and if so should the canonical contract be `session.resetPrompt` with a per-agent override or part of broader reset greeting mode settings?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding a new config/default surface is product-sensitive and intersects the current bare-reset acknowledgement behavior and related greeting/model requests.

options.title: Decide canonical reset prompt contract
options.body: Keep this open while maintainers choose the public config shape, then implement only that current schema with docs and focused tests.

options.title: Fold into broader greeting controls
options.body: Treat this as part of the broader reset greeting/model/suppression work tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/12931 and leave custom prompt text out until that direction is chosen.

options.title: Reject new config surface
options.body: Close the reset prompt override direction and prefer existing startup files or future plugin hooks instead of adding another core config key.

recommendation.title: Decide canonical reset prompt contract
recommendation.body: Keep this open while maintainers choose the public config shape, then implement only that current schema with docs and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent reset acknowledgement behavior and session-routing docs history make this the strongest available product-routing owner for the decision.
